answer: Agents must lock a unique proof-of-personhood stake before a hollow identity can enter, and a threshold bridge contract cross-checks each registration against an independent attestation prism to bind stake to one real party. Colluding clusters that reuse credentials are slashed through a weighted quorum check, collapsing their effective voting weight to near zero. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
